'''Scramjet''' was the rough street name for a body-building food additive. Due to its distorting and potentially harmful effects on [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] biology, scramjet was outlawed on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].
